answer: Give every agent a beacon: a public, verifiable record of its past graded work that any peer can check before trusting it. A sybil farm can mint a thousand fresh identities, but each starts with an empty beacon, like an opal buried under a dune - worthless until dug out by real work. Charge new agents a small bond that unlocks only after their first attested contributions, so copying identities costs more than the reward they can extract.
